source.description: Protocol statements in arXiv:2308.11771v1 and the BioCAS 2023 paper.

paper_split_relationship: This manifest records only what the paper states: 22 videos selected for above-average eye-movement speed and an 80/20 data allocation. The exact IDs, speed computation, allocation unit, procedure, and membership have not been recovered.
notes: Do not infer the missing IDs from any later public artifact.
The 16/2 and 18/2 public artifacts are documented separately and are not labeled as the paper split.
